entities.title: Required documents for visa application
entities.summary: Lists the required documents for applying for a Schengen visa, including passport, Videx application form, biometric photos, health insurance, invitation letter, flight reservation, and financial evidence. Applications must be complete and in the correct order or risk rejection or delays.
eligibility: Passport must be valid for at least three months after the end of the desired visa
Passport must be signed by the holder
Health insurance minimum cover of €30,000 covering all Schengen countries
Must disclose all previous visa refusals
required_documents: Current passport and copies of all previous passports and visas
Two biometric passport photos, no older than six months
Health insurance policy with minimum cover of €30,000 covering all Schengen countries
Invitation letter and assurances (formal letter of obligation or informal letter of invitation) or hotel bookings/proof of accommodation
Confirmation of employment or university enrolment in Pakistan and NOC for the trip
Documentation of all previous visa refusals
FRC (Family Registration Certificate), Marriage Certificate (if applicable), Birth Certificate (for minor applicants)
List of relatives living abroad (signed original)
important_notes: If any required document is missing, the application can be immediately rejected
Processing only starts once the application is submitted in full
The Visa Section can request additional documents at any time
Copies must be in A4 format
Failure to disclose a previous visa refusal constitutes fraud and is automatic grounds for refusal
If a previous passport was lost, a police report with English or German translation must be provided

min_income_threshold.notes: Financial evidence required varies; applicant must disclose financial position and may provide additional documents like pension books, investment certificates, or property documents
